config.bootstrap: paired image-level resampling, same indices for all arms
config.orig_arm: detector on EXIF-corrected original (BGR array) at imgsz=train_imgsz; OBB vertices mapped dihedral->per-axis stretch->ECC affine into 704 space; int-cast like detected_boxes_eval
config.det704_arm: detector on 704 benchmark JPEG path with checkpoint default imgsz (as detected_boxes_eval)
config.conf_filtering: one inference at conf=min(confs), then filtered; lower-conf boxes cannot suppress higher-conf boxes in NMS so this equals separate runs (up to max_det)
